def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    base = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", title.lower()).strip("-")
    suffix = secrets.token_hex(4)
    return f"{base}-{suffix}"

article = Article(
    slug=slugify(title),
    title=title,
...
@app.get("/api/articles/{slug}")
def get_article(slug: str, session: Session = Depends(get_session), viewer: Optional[User] = Depends(get_current_user_optional)):
    article = session.exec(select(Article).where(Article.slug == slug)).first()

It creates articles at POST /api/articles with status 201 and returns the article payload including title, description, tagList, and slug, and it supports retrieving the same article by slug via GET /api/articles/{slug} with a 200 response containing the article title.
